name: CommonThreadBench v1 scenario dataset
provenance: Hand-curated synthetic scenarios. No live Qloo response bodies, credentials or private data are embedded.

scenarios.title: Two indie-music friends
scenarios.notes: Clear overlapping anchor (Radiohead) should surface shared-ground coverage.

scenarios.title: Two Ghibli-and-ramen friends
scenarios.notes: Near-identical tastes; expect strong shared-ground coverage.

scenarios.title: Metal vs. classical
scenarios.notes: Disjoint tastes; a labelled cultural bridge should only appear with real multi-profile evidence.

scenarios.title: One loud voice, two quiet
scenarios.notes: p1 has the most interests; worst-member coverage must not collapse to zero silently.

scenarios.title: Obscure vs. popular music
scenarios.notes: Niche interests may resolve sparsely; mainstream should resolve well.

scenarios.title: Anime fan meets jazz fan
scenarios.notes: A defensible bridge needs genuine multi-profile provenance; otherwise label neutral.

scenarios.title: Phoenix the band, not the city
scenarios.notes: 'Phoenix' resolves to a city first; intended entity is the band.

scenarios.title: Tight budget cap
scenarios.notes: All displayed options must satisfy the per-person budget.

scenarios.title: Very high budget, no exclusion
scenarios.notes: High budget should not over-constrain; most candidates remain feasible.

scenarios.title: Exclusion removes all candidates
scenarios.notes: Intended to produce an empty feasible set after exclusions.
